purpose: Build, (re)create, start, and attach to containers for the project's services. The most-used compose subcommand. Builds images for services with a `build` block (unless `--pull always`). Brings up `depends_on` graph in topological order; honors `condition: service_healthy`. By default streams logs to stdout; `-d` for detached.

flags.name: -d, --detach
flags.doc: Detached mode. Returns immediately; check logs with `docker compose logs -f`.

flags.name: --build
flags.doc: Build images before starting (overrides cached images).

flags.name: --no-build
flags.doc: Don't build, even if image is missing (errors out).

flags.name: --force-recreate
flags.doc: Recreate containers even if config + image unchanged.

flags.name: --no-recreate
flags.doc: If containers exist, don't recreate them.

flags.name: --remove-orphans
flags.doc: Remove containers for services no longer in compose file.

flags.name: --scale
flags.doc: Override deploy.replicas for one service. Repeatable.

flags.name: --abort-on-container-exit
flags.doc: Stop ALL containers when any one exits. Useful for run-once test stacks.

flags.name: --exit-code-from
flags.doc: Return the exit code of the named service. Implies --abort-on-container-exit.

flags.name: --attach
flags.doc: Restrict log streaming to listed services. Repeatable.

flags.name: --no-attach
flags.doc: Don't stream logs from these services. Repeatable.

flags.name: -t, --timeout
flags.doc: Stop timeout in seconds before SIGKILL.

flags.name: --wait
flags.doc: Block until services are healthy/exited. Pairs with `--wait-timeout`.

flags.name: -w, --watch
flags.doc: Run develop.watch rules — file watcher for sync/rebuild on change.

flags.name: --no-log-prefix
flags.doc: Don't prefix log lines with the service name.

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.doc: Print what would happen, change nothing.

examples.expected_output: streams interleaved logs from all services with prefix `<service> | `
blocks until all services become healthy or exit 0; exit non-zero on timeout
examples.scenario: CI smoke-test where you need to know when the stack is ready

examples.expected_output: runs services + file-watcher; on file change, syncs/rebuilds per develop.watch[]

purpose: Stop and remove containers, networks. Volumes preserved by default (use `-v` to also remove). Reverse-order shutdown of `depends_on` graph.

flags.name: -v, --volumes
flags.doc: Also remove named volumes declared in volumes section AND anonymous volumes attached to containers.

flags.name: --rmi
flags.doc: Remove images. `local` removes only images without a custom tag.

flags.name: --remove-orphans
flags.doc: Also remove containers for services not in the compose file.

examples.expected_output: containers stopped + removed; networks removed; named volumes preserved
also removes named volumes + locally-built images
examples.scenario: full cleanup of a project's resources

examples.expected_output: sweeps containers from services that were removed from the compose file

purpose: List containers in the project. Default columns: NAME, IMAGE, COMMAND, SERVICE, CREATED, STATUS, PORTS. Filterable by service name.

flags.name: -a, --all
flags.doc: Show stopped containers too (default: only running).

flags.name: --services
flags.doc: Print service names only (one per line).

flags.name: --orphans
flags.doc: Include orphan containers (services no longer in compose file).

examples.expected_output: JSON array of exited services in this project

purpose: Fetch + stream logs from project services. Multi-service streams are interleaved with a `<service> | ` prefix. Subset of services via positional args.

flags.name: --no-log-prefix
flags.doc: Don't prefix lines with service name.

flags.name: --since
flags.doc: Show logs since RFC3339 / Unix / Go duration (`42m`).

flags.name: -i, --index
flags.doc: For replicated services, pick a specific replica's logs.

examples.expected_output: errors in the last 5 minutes across all services

purpose: Execute a command in a RUNNING service container. Mirrors `docker exec`. Picks the first replica if multiple.

flags.name: -T, --no-TTY
flags.doc: Disable pseudo-TTY (default false). Set true in CI.

flags.name: --privileged
flags.doc: Extended privileges for the exec'd command.

flags.name: --index
flags.doc: Pick a specific replica by index.

examples.expected_output: interactive shell in the web container

examples.invocation: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres
examples.expected_output: non-tty psql session — usable from a CI script

purpose: Run a one-off container against a service definition. Doesn't reuse the service's running container — creates a new one each time. By default, also brings up its `depends_on` graph (so DB is up before the migration runs).

flags.name: --rm
flags.doc: Remove the container after exit. Foot-gun: NOT default — `compose run` containers leak by default.

flags.name: --service-ports
flags.doc: Use the service's defined ports (default: don't, to avoid conflicts with the running service).

flags.name: --use-aliases
flags.doc: Use the service's network aliases (default: don't, since aliases would collide with the running service).

purpose: Build images for services that have a `build` block. Reuses BuildKit. Subset by service name(s).

flags.name: --ssh
flags.doc: SSH agent socket / keys for build.

flags.name: --parallel
flags.doc: Build images in parallel (default in modern Compose).

purpose: Restart service containers. Doesn't recreate — same container, just stop+start. For config changes that took effect on restart, use `up` instead (or with `--force-recreate`).

flags.name: --no-deps
flags.doc: Don't restart linked dependencies (default DOES restart on `depends_on.<svc>.restart: true`).
